decisions.reason: The conditional prize-claim interaction occurs after winner selection and does not change the Chainlink VRF selection method, eligible population, weighting, trigger, or verification.
Changing prize delivery copy from direct wallet payout to a conditional claim button does not alter the NFT metadata fields, ticket association, or reward-accounting accuracy requirements.
The prize-claim interaction does not change publication of prize-pool values or the public next-draw sales counter.
